summary: Added postExecutionReview to PlanBuildGate and planner parsing, implemented post-execution read-only Claude diff review (120s timeout) with fail-open handling and completion-message reporting, and added a single-cycle synthetic system-polish step (no ralph) when actionable issues are returned. Also updated planner/agent-executor tests for the new behavior. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm build, and pnpm vitest run src/goal/.
